booking.source: FS page ('Reservations not accepted. All sites first-come, first-served.'); recreation.gov search finds no listing

fees.source: FS page ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night')

sites.source: FS page ('This heavily wooded campground has 33 sites'); site map (sites 1-33, 1-4 marked 'Walk in sites')

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'); site map (restrooms and water spigots)

season.source: FS page (Seasons of Use 'Mid-May to Mid-October')

discounts.source: FS page ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: On the Kancamagus Highway 14 miles west of Conway, with the Swift River a short distance away. Sites 1-4 are walk-in. The UNH Trail to Mount Hedgehog and the Downes Brook and Mount Potash trails start across the highway. --Claude
summary: FS page + site map: 33 sites (1-4 walk-in), all first-come (no rec.gov listing), $30 + $6 extra vehicle, vault toilets + water, mid-May to mid-October. Rig length unverified. Not waterfront stays.
flags: Rig length (inclusion check): no source gives site lengths (no rec.gov catalog; FS page silent). The old note's 'a 23-ft rig fits some sites but not the largest rigs' is unverified; the site map shows 29 drive-in spurs on two loops. Kept as stored (pad size unclear = keep with caveat).

Waterfront: not waterfront stays. The site map puts the Swift River north of the loops (21 and 22 nearest); Esri 43.9985,-71.3710 shows continuous canopy down to a river ~15-25 m wide with gravel bars - creekside width at most and under canopy; the stored evidence also cites a high bank at 21 and 23.
Phone 603-536-6100 (WMNF Supervisor's Office) kept. Website unchanged.
Pin 43.99764,-71.37096 = FS lat/long; the loops are under canopy (~100-200 m north of the highway on the map); no move proposed.
Note rewritten: the old one repeated sites, hookups and season.
